entities.summary: Ignacio Buse is a Peruvian professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 59 achieved on 30 March 2026 and a best doubles ranking of No. 439 reached on 16 October 2023. He is currently the No. 1 singles player from Peru.
